claim: ans: "Chasselas (Sauvignon Blanc is permitted as a minority partner)"; accept: "chasselas with sauvignon a permitted minority partner", "chasselas led with some sauvignon"
because: The Pouilly-sur-Loire cahier des charges (Décret n° 2011-784 of 28 June 2011) sets the encépagement as Chasselas B alone. Sauvignon B keeps the appellation only as a transitional exception: mixed plantings of Chasselas with some Sauvignon vines that were in place on 31 July 2009 stay eligible until they are grubbed up. Sauvignon has not been a permitted blending partner since the 2011 cahier.
fix: ans: "Chasselas (the only permitted variety; Sauvignon survives only in mixed parcels planted before 31 July 2009, until they are pulled up); Pouilly-Fumé is Sauvignon Blanc". Delete "chasselas with sauvignon a permitted minority partner" and "chasselas led with some sauvignon" from accept.
